title: Rotational Temperature
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly identify T_R as 75 K.

title: Vibrational Temperature
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly identify T_V as 6250 K.

title: C_v at T1
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly calculate C_v as 12.5 J/K/mol for T1.

title: C_p at T1
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly calculate C_p as 20.8 J/K/mol for T1.

title: C_v at T2
description: Important Criteria: The student should calculate C_v as 20.8 J/K/mol for T2.

title: C_p at T2
description: Important Criteria: The student should calculate C_p as 29.1 J/K/mol for T2.

title: C_v at T3
description: Important Criteria: The student should recognize that C_v remains 20.8 J/K/mol for T3.

title: C_p at T3
description: Important Criteria: The student should recognize that C_p remains 29.1 J/K/mol for T3.

title: C_v at T4
description: Important Criteria: The student should calculate C_v as 29.1 J/K/mol for T4.

title: C_p at T4
description: Important Criteria: The student should calculate C_p as 37.4 J/K/mol for T4.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common errors in calculating specific heats or temperatures.
